For the [[Added Effect]] in {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}, see [[Disguise (Mechanic)]].}} {{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Artwork EoW= [[File:EoW Disguise Artwork.png|320x320px]] |Render EoW= [[File:EoW Princess Zelda Render 4.png|320x320px]] |Model EoW= [[File:EoW Disguise Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite EoW= [[File:EoW Disguise Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= EoW |other= |pronunciation= |plural= |cost= |value= |location= [[Hyrule Castle Underground]] |uses= |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} The '''Disguise''' is an [[Item]] in {{EoW}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Disguise||Series, EoW}} | {{EoW}} }} ==Location and Uses== {{Descriptions EoW}} The Disguise is worn by [[Princess Zelda]] after she escapes from the [[Hyrule Castle Underground]]. It is comprised of a dress given to her by [[Impa]] and [[Link]]'s hood. When Zelda is wearing the Disguise, her identity will be concealed. This results in [[Soldier]]s and residents of [[Hyrule Castle Town]] being unable to recognize her. The [[Clothing]]'s scent is described to be similar to a musty dresser. Until Zelda has completed the [[Main Quest]] "[[Still Missing]]", she will be unable to change out of her Disguise. [[File:EoW Minister Lefte.png|thumb|left|250px|alt= A screenshot of Princess Zelda, Minister Lefte, and Tri in Suthorn Forest. The hood on Zelda's disguise is lowered.|Zelda lowering the hood of her Disguise]] After Zelda mends the [[Rift]] in [[Suthorn Forest]] during the Main Quest "[[The Mysterious Rifts]]", [[Minister Lefte]] appears outside the [[Suthorn Ruins]], although she does not initially recognize Zelda due to her Disguise. When the pair visit [[Lueburry's House]], [[Lueburry]] will not speak to them until he recognizes Link's cloak, at which point he questions Zelda about him. Later on, at the end of the Main Quest "[[The Jabul Waters Rift]]", [[General Wright]] also does not immediately recognize Zelda after being rescued, though he finds her familiar. As a result, Zelda reveals her identity to him as well. When Zelda reunites with the [[King of Hyrule]] at the end of the Main Quest" Still Missing", he is able to see through her Disguise immediately. When Zelda wears the Disguise, many of the residents of [[Suthorn Village]] will comment on the cloak due to their familiarity with Link. When Zelda speaks to [[Jacint]] prior to completing "The Mysterious Rifts", he will recognize that her hood resembles Link's and hopes that he is well. The leader of Suthorn Village also recognizes the hood, though he is distracted by his wife being trapped in a Rift. A [[Hylian]] woman asks Zelda if someone gave it to her, noting its similarity to Link's. After "The Mysterious Rifts" has been completed, the villagers will talk to Zelda more about her Disguise's cloak. If Zelda approaches Jacint after completing the [[Side Quest]] "[[Finding the Flying Plant]]", he will once again comment on how her hood reminds him of Link. [[Oethera]] calls the hood lovely, and she states that she believes Zelda can defeat [[Monster]]s while wearing it. The leader of Suthorn Village comments on how similar her cloak is to Link's, and he asks if they are in style. The Hylian woman talks about Link, stating that he is on a journey and that she is worried about when he will return. Her son expresses a desire to have a similar cloak. The proprietor of the [[Suthorn Village Shop]] plans to stock the hoods if they are trending. During the Side Quest "[[Up a Wall]]", [[Verley]] will initially believe that Zelda is Link because of the hood, though he apologizes for his mistake afterwards. After completing "Still Missing", the residents of Suthorn Village will begin to talk about Link if Zelda wears her Disguise around them. Jacint is reminded of happy memories of Link when he sees the hood. Oethera asks Zelda if she is on a journey, and she reminds her not to spend too much time away from her home. The village leader mistakes Zelda for Link, expressing that the villagers are eagerly awaiting his return. Seeing the cloak, the leader's wife mentions that modern trends are different from when she was younger. The shopkeeper recalls that Link used to help him taste-test his products. After completing the Side Quest "[[What Is Snow...Really?]]", the child still wants a cloak of his own. Due to Link's adventures, people outside of Suthorn Village recognize the Diguise's cloak as well. At the [[Oasis]] in the [[Gerudo Desert]], a [[Gerudo Soldier]] recalls how Link saved her from falling into a Rift and defeated Monsters, which inspired her to become a Soldier. In [[Kakariko Village]], a [[Hylian]] family will initially confuse Zelda for Link, explaining that he prevented them from being stolen away by a Rift as well. If Zelda wears the Disguise in front of [[Condé]], he remembers that Link pulled him out of the [[Still World]] in the past. If Zelda wears her Disguise in Hyrule Castle Town after completing "Still Missing", the residents will not recognize her. As a result, they will treat her differently and make admissions they would not normally. [[Romi]] will initially recognize Zelda, but she begins to doubt herself and becomes confused. Romi's father, however, admits that he is too busy judging others to speak to Zelda. Romi's cousin criticizes her uncle, but she notes that he is loving to Romi. Zelda can overhear the Hylians near the fountain discussing the [[Stamp Guy]] and planning to call Soldiers to arrest him. The Hylian next to the [[Weathervane]] will initially brag about having spoken to Zelda before. After being introduced to [[Tri]], he will recognize Zelda after noticing Tri is following her. His younger brother, who can be found in the [[House]] across the courtyard, comments on how nice his brother is to him. Their father recalls that he was once an adventurer, and he swam to the [[Sea Zora Village]] during this time. Their mother remembers he used to come back injured, and she recommends always having healing [[Item]]s. The elderly Hylian in the [[House]] near the Town's gate will be able to recognize Zelda, though she is embarrassed by how long it took her. The man whose House was consumed by a Rift will express his relief that his home was restored. His sister complains about his desire to move to the wilderness, since their home is in an ideal location and was left to them by their mother. The woman standing by the [[Well]] will struggle to come up with a way to start a conversation with the man she sees at the [[Bottom of the Well (Hyrule Castle Town)|Bottom of the Well]]. A Hylian girl wishes that Zelda was there to play with her. A young woman considers writing down recent events so that future historians can have a firsthand account. The family that runs the [[Hyrule Castle Town Shop]] will advertise their wares, with the shopkeeper claiming their goods are utilized by the King of Hyrule and Princess Zelda. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:EoW Disguise Artwork 2.png|{{Game Label|{{EoW|-}}}}Alternate artwork of Zelda wearing her Disguise File:EoW Princess Zelda Render.png|{{Game Label|{{EoW|-}}}}Render of Zelda wearing her Disguise File:EoW Disguise Promotional Screenshot.png|{{Game Label|{{EoW|-}}}}Promotional screenshot of Princess Zelda wearing the Disguise File:EoW Disguise.png|{{Game Label|{{EoW|-}}}}Princess Zelda wearing the Disguise File:EoW Disguise Reveal.png|{{Game Label|{{EoW|-}}}}Zelda after lowering the hood of her Disguise File:EoW Disguise Model 2.png|{{Game Label|{{EoW|-}}}}The cloak used for the Disguise File:EoW Disguise Model 3.png|{{Game Label|{{EoW|-}}}}The Disguise with the hood lowered ==See Also== {{See Also| * Clothing }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|{{Color EoW|Pink|Disguise}}}}
